negative_compilation_note: For Full models and a non-none UC preset with nonempty prefix, the official client prepends nsfw to the final negative prompt if the compiled positive base prompt does not include nsfw (case-insensitive). Curated models do not use this auto-add. Add preset text literally on client side; merely sending ucPresetId or qualityPresetId is not a substitute for compiling the prompt.

nai-diffusion-5-full.note: seed is supplied at request time. input/negative text and v4 prompt objects are compiled from selected presets. image_format defaults to webp on current official API requests; the UI converts arrivals to PNG by default. The direct API example deliberately asks for png. These are inspected client defaults, not a complete formally published server schema.
